description:
Outcome
Authoring, property, and corpus files use final namespace owners and have clear claim ownership.

Requirements and decisions
R1-R8, R10-R14, R16; KTD1-KTD5, KTD7-KTD9.

Affected surfaces
test/authoring/**; test/property/**; test/test_helper.exs; mix.exs; test/quality/component_proof.yml; test/quality/quality_contract.yml; test/quality/source_manifest.yml; and lane READMEs.

Implementation direction
Move Agent and Flow authoring to test/authoring/{jido_agent,jido_flow}. Move property families to test/property/{jido_agent_server,jido_expr,jido_signal} and Signal corpus to test/property/corpus/jido_signal. Rename modules and update loaders and report selection. Register a DSL or generated-invariant claim as canonical when only this lane proves it. Link a repeated runtime claim to its canonical owner as supplemental evidence. Update only source-manifest target_path values. Preserve source_path history.

Acceptance
Agent and Flow authoring run together and stay out of default. Property and fuzz aliases select all three families. Focused files use only their family policy. Signal corpus replay passes. Each evidence group either owns a distinct DSL or invariant claim, or links to an existing canonical runtime claim. Manifest targets exist and are unique.

Verification
mix test.authoring --warnings-as-errors
mix test.property --warnings-as-errors
mix test.fuzz --warnings-as-errors
mix test test/quality/source_manifest_test.exs test/quality/component_proof_test.exs --seed 0
mix format --check-formatted

Completion signal
Authoring and property proof pass from final paths, claim ownership is complete, and U5 can start.
title: U4 Reorganize authoring and property proof
